questions.explanation: Kite area is half the product of diagonals: 0.5*6*4 = 12. The note doubled it. options.text: Because base and slant side are equal
Because slant side is always zero
Because height is the perpendicular distance between bases

questions.explanation: Area uses perpendicular height between bases, not the slant side. Slant side is longer than height. The key is D, "Because height is the perpendicular distance between bases", because it is the only choice consistent with the relation used above. Every other choice fails for a specific reason: A ("Because base and slant side are equal") assumes equality; B ("Because slant side is always zero") nonsensical claim; C ("Because area ignores height entirely") ignores height.
